newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Refining to end output cut this week.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Refining to end output cut this week.

text.p: Singapore Refining Co (SRC) plans to end its output cut of an average of 40,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) later this week, a company source said on Tuesday.
The source said the delayed crude shipment which had led to the cuts on January 23, arrived February 3.
But runs on Tuesday afternoon were still down and would only be raised to full capacity of 285,000-bpd later this week when delivery of the cargo to the SRC refinery is completed, he said.
